title: Network pharmacology and molecular docking approach to explore the potential mechanisms of Xuefu Zhuyu Capsule in coronary heart disease.
authors: Qian, He; Chen, Bing-Bing; Zhang, Min; Zeng, San-Jin; Jia, Zhuang-Zhuang; Wang, Shuo; Gao, Shan; Shi, An-Hua; Xie, Jing
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究血府逐瘀胶囊治疗冠心病的机制，虽涉及蛋白靶点对接，但核心是药物-疾病网络而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Xuefu Zhuyu Capsule (XFZYC) plays a pivotal role in treating coronary heart disease (CHD) because of its potent clinical effects and fewer side effects. However, the possible pharmacological effect on CHD is limited. Thus, this research systematically analyzes XFZYC and CHD through network pharmacology technology. We identified 139 active compounds and 127 overlapped target genes in 11 herbs of XFZYC by using network pharmacology, and these 127 genes regulated the major signaling pathways related to CHD. The analysis of protein-protein interaction networks demonstrated that 30 important gene targets, such as interleukin-6, signal transducer and activator of transcription 3, protein kinase B1, mitogen activated protein kinases 3, cellular tumor antigen p53, vascular endothelial growth factor A, transcription factor p65, and proto-oncogene c-Fos, participated in the regulation of 79 major signaling pathways related to CHD. On this basis, we found that protein kinase B1, cellular tumor antigen p53, and transcription factor p65, which played a role in multiple regulatory pathways of the network, were also regulated by more than 3 compounds and expressed in at least 4 herbs. Molecular docking showed that XFZYC had a good binding potential with the overlapped protein targets. Gene Ontology enrichment analysis revealed that the active targets involved a various of biological process, cellular component, and molecular function, which included the key ones such as positive regulation of transcription from RNA polymerase II promoter, plasma membrane, and protein binding. T cell receptor signaling pathway, programmed death-ligand 1 expression and programmed death cell receptor-1 checkpoint pathway in cancer, FOXO signaling pathway, Ras signaling pathway, interleukin-17 signaling pathway, and VEGF signaling pathway, which were selected from Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes, were closely related to XFZYC in the treatment of CHD. XFZYC has a potential pharmacological effect on CHD, which provides the value for further study of XFZYC's therapeutic effect on CHD.
abstract_zh: 血府逐瘀胶囊（XFZYC）在治疗冠心病（CHD）中发挥关键作用，因其显著的临床疗效和较少的副作用。然而，其对CHD可能的药理作用研究有限。因此，本研究通过网络药理学技术系统分析XFZYC与CHD。我们利用网络药理学方法，在XFZYC的11种草药中鉴定出139种活性化合物和127个重叠靶基因，这些127个基因调控与CHD相关的主要信号通路。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络分析表明，30个重要基因靶点，如白细胞介素-6、信号转导与转录激活因子3、蛋白激酶B1、丝裂原活化蛋白激酶3、细胞肿瘤抗原p53、血管内皮生长因子A、转录因子p65和原癌基因c-Fos，参与调控与CHD相关的79条主要信号通路。在此基础上，我们发现蛋白激酶B1、细胞肿瘤抗原p53和转录因子p65在网络的多条调控通路中发挥作用，同时受超过3种化合物调控，并在至少4种草药中表达。分子对接显示，XFZYC与重叠蛋白靶点具有良好的结合潜力。基因本体论富集分析揭示，活性靶点涉及多种生物过程、细胞组分和分子功能，其中包括关键项如RNA聚合酶II启动子转录的正调控、质膜和蛋白质结合。从京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）中选出的T细胞受体信号通路、程序性死亡配体1表达及程序性死亡细胞受体1检查点通路（在癌症中）、FOXO信号通路、Ras信号通路、白细胞介素-17信号通路和VEGF信号通路，与XFZYC治疗CHD密切相关。XFZYC对CHD具有潜在药理作用，这为进一步研究XFZYC对CHD的治疗效果提供了价值。
